passive.name: All-In
passive.text: Increases the wearer's DEF by **40/46/52/58/64%**. When the wearer provides a Shield to an ally, the wearer's CRIT DMG increases by **40/46/52/58/64%**, lasting for **2** turn(s). When the wearer's Follow-Up ATK hits an enemy target, there is a **100/115/130/145/160%** base chance to increase the DMG taken by the attacked enemy target by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%**, lasting for **2** turn(s).

passive.name: Sweet Dream
passive.text: Increases the wearer's provided Shield Effect by **12/15/18/21/24%**. While an ally target has a Shield, their DMG dealt increases by **12/14/16/18/20%**.

weapons.name: Day One of My New Life

passive.name: At This Very Moment
passive.text: Increases the wearer's DEF by **16/18/20/22/24%**. After entering battle, increases All-Type RES of all allies by **8/9/10/11/12%**. Abilities of the same type cannot stack.

passive.name: Treasure
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Effect RES by **8/10/12/14/16%**. If the wearer is attacked and has no Shield, they gain a Shield equal to **16/20/24/28/32%** of their Max HP for **2** turn(s). This effect can only be triggered once every **3** turn(s). If the wearer has a Shield when attacked, the DMG they receive decreases by **12/15/18/21/24%**.

passive.name: Verdict
passive.text: Increases the wearer's DEF by **24/28/32/36/40%** and Effect Hit Rate by **24/28/32/36/40%**. Increases the chance for the wearer to be attacked by enemies. When the wearer is attacked, increase their DEF by an extra **24/28/32/36/40%** until the end of the wearer's turn.

passive.name: Time Fleets Away
passive.text: The wearer is more likely to be attacked, and DMG taken is reduced by **16/18/20/22/24%**.

passive.name: A New Round of Shuffling
passive.text: Increases the wearer's DEF by **16/20/24/28/32%**. When the wearer is attacked, there is a **100/105/110/115/120%** base chance to Burn the enemy. For each turn, the wearer deals DoT that is equal to **40/50/60/70/80%** of the wearer's DEF for **2** turn(s).

substatLine: Effect Hit Rate = SPD (Breakpoint) > DEF% > HP% = Effect RES

entries.name: Frigid Cold Arrow
entries.text: Deals Ice DMG equal to **100%** of March 7th's ATK to one enemy.

entries.name: The Power of Cuteness
entries.text:
Provides a single ally with a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to **57%** of March 7th's DEF plus **760** for **3** turn(s).
If the ally's current HP percentage is **30%** or higher, greatly increases the chance of enemies attacking that ally.

entries.name: Glacial Cascade
entries.text:
Deals Ice DMG equal to **150%** of March 7th's ATK to all enemies. Hit enemies have a **50%** base chance to be Frozen for **1** turn(s).
While Frozen, enemies cannot take action and will receive Ice Additional DMG equal to **60%** of March 7th's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

entries.name: Girl Power
entries.text: After a Shielded ally is attacked by an enemy, March 7th immediately Counters, dealing Ice DMG equal to **100%** of her ATK. This effect can be triggered **2** time(s) each turn.

entries.name: Freezing Beauty
entries.text:
Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, there is a **100%** base chance to Freeze a random enemy for **1** turn(s).
While Frozen, the enemy cannot take action and will take Ice Additional DMG equal to **50%** of March 7th's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

entries.name: Purify
entries.text: When using Skill, dispels 1 debuff from one designated ally.

entries.name: Reinforce
entries.text: The duration of the Shield generated from Skill is extended for **1** turn(s).

entries.name: Ice Spell
entries.text: When using Ultimate, increases the base chance to Freeze enemies by **15%**.

entries.name: Memory of You
entries.text: Every time March 7th's Ultimate Freezes a target, she regenerates 6 Energy.

entries.name: Memory of It
entries.text: Upon entering battle, grants a Shield equal to 24% of March 7th's DEF plus 320 to the ally with the lowest HP percentage, lasting for 3 turn(s).

entries.name: Memory of Everything
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Never Forfeit Again
entries.text: The Talent's Counter effect can be triggered 1 more time in each turn. The DMG dealt by Counter increases by an amount that is equal to 30% of March 7th's DEF.

entries.name: Never Forget Again
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Just Like This, Always...
entries.text: Allies under the protection of the Shield granted by the Skill restore HP equal to 4% of their Max HP plus 106 at the beginning of each turn.
